title: Otori Emu — Profile Story

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll go next!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Good good good wonderhoy☆
I'm Emu Otori from Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're supposed to say something about ourselves for our self-intros, right...? Umm... What should I talk about...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Until just recently, I was a first-year in high school, but I'm finally a second-year!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And for this upcoming school year, I'm gonna be a class representative—

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Too much personal information...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right...!
I should probably talk about all the stuff we've done up until now like Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, uh...
Do you all know about Phoenix Wonderland?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's an amusement park located in Shibuya, and the person who built it was my grandpa!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been going since I was little and really, really love that place. I've lost count of how many times I went, but it was always a place that was full of smiles...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But after Grandpa passed away, it became harder and harder to keep the park running...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right about when the park was in really big trouble, Tsukasa and the others came along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We became Wonderlands×Showtime soon after and started putting on lots and lots of shows together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: More and more visitors gradually began coming to see them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And now, Phoenix Wonderland is full of smiling faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was my dream to bring smiles back to that place... I'm super duper happy now, and I can't thank the others enough!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, but!
My dream still hasn't fully come true yet!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna fill this park with even more smiles! That's why I'm leaving the park with the others! To learn how to do that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Wait, I'm back to the present... Then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's it for my self-intro!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huuuh...?
That didn't really end with a bang like one of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, you understand how I feel?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yippee!
Thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, Nene, you're next!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our self-intros feel like little shows! I can't wait to see what Nene says♪
